newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CANTONA SUSPENDED FOR TWO MATCHES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CANTONA SUSPENDED FOR TWO MATCHES.

text.p: Manchester United's Eric Cantona has been suspended for two matches after being booked in Saturday's F.A. Cup tie against Wimbledon.

He will have to sit out United's premier league clash at Arsenal on February 19 and could miss a potential fifth round F.A. Cup match against first division Queens Park Rangers on the preceding weekend.
The suspension is the Frenchman's first in the two years since he was banned for an infamous assault on a Crystal Palace fan during a match in January 1995.
